The two variables are statistically independent in this data. A chi-square test on their cross-tabulation gives p ≈ 0.48. Among the 16,384 patients, 10.2% have R thumb trouble and 1.3% have L Central chest pain. The chest pain rate is about the same with and without thumb trouble (1.07% against 1.33%). There is no evidence of a causal link in either direction.

ANSWER: C
